$comment: Generated by `npm run music:sync` from the Spotify Web API. Do not hand-edit.
This is the committed empty state. Until a sync runs, `tracks` is empty and
the homepage renders no ON ROTATION section at all — the section is not a
placeholder that sits there looking broken.
To fill it, once:      npm run music:auth   (one browser consent)
then, any time:        npm run music:sync
See the header of scripts/spotify-sync.mjs for what the fields mean and
README.md for the three credentials it needs.
